# Music Coach

> Music Coach is a free, open-source (MIT) Mac app that teaches people who don't play an instrument to make music and learn GarageBand. Guided lessons take you from your first chord to a finished track. It runs on your Mac and opens in Chrome; your files stay on your Mac, and there's no account. Made by Stylus Nexus Holdings LLC.

- Latest release: see https://github.com/stylusnexus/music-coach/releases/latest (about 1 MB)
- Needs: a Mac with GarageBand 10.4.14 or later (free; macOS 15.6+), Google Chrome, Python 3.9 or newer. A MIDI keyboard is optional; computer keys work too.
- Mac only for now. Windows, and lessons for Logic Pro and Ableton Live, are planned.

## What you learn

- Make music first: chords, a drum machine, an arpeggiator that does the picking for you, a looper and a sampler. Everything you play already sounds good.
- Then learn GarageBand: take your sketch into GarageBand and learn its tools step by step, with real screenshots: tracks, the grid, the Piano Roll, mixing, fades, exporting, and making instruments sound real. Optionally, carry it on to GarageBand on iPhone or iPad.
- Styles: pick up to 5 styles to start, from folk, punk and house to lo-fi hip-hop, dub, shoegaze, bossa nova and ambient. Each has a 5-second taste played by the app and a real record to hear on Bandcamp. Every starter style works on a Mac with nothing extra installed.
- Lessons that notice: short lessons tick themselves off as you play. A take coach scores chords, timing, feel, sound and ending from what it measured, and names one thing to try next.
- Your gear, by name: it finds the plugins on your Mac and sorts them by what they do. Point it at your sample folders and the Sampler lists every pack in them, sorted and searchable. Lessons name your own gear when you have it, and GarageBand's built-in effects when you don't.
- Play by ear (optional): find the home note by ear, echo short tunes back, and hear tension and rest, counting notes from home (1 to 7) instead of naming them.
- Updates: Check for updates in About asks GitHub for the latest version and links the download. The app is signed and notarized by Apple.

## Coach model and privacy

- The coach model is optional. Lessons, the studio and take scores all work without one; only written summaries and questions need it.
- Choose a model running on your Mac in LM Studio, or bring your own key for OpenAI, Anthropic, or a service like Ollama or OpenRouter.
- Progress, gear list, sketches and key stay in local files. The app goes online only to reach the coach model you picked, when you press Hear it to play a style's track from Bandcamp, or when you press Check for updates. The coach model gets your questions and the names of your gear and plugins, never your files or recordings.
